description:
Required Skills:
•    5-7 years of experience in Business Objects business intelligence systems design, architecture, development, testing, deployment, and support. 
•    Experience with Business Objects in the supply chain management 
•    Experience with Business Objects based development over a SAP BW environment (SAP is primary data source) and non-SAP environments. 
•    Thorough understanding of Business Objects product suite including - BO Enterprise; OLAP Universes; Web Intelligence; Dashboards(Xcelsius); Live Office; Explorer; Crystal Reports; Mobile; Voyager; Integration Kits; Data Federator; Data Services; Metadata Management. 
•    Thorough understanding of Business Objects based design and development processes including - universe design and development, reports/dashboard design and development, and business intelligence reporting strategies.


 Duration:  6+ Months 
 Hire Type: Contract, C2C or 1099 
 Rate: DOE 
 Visa: H1, GC or USC only! 
 Travel Covered: No.  

 

 Apply today!
